channel.title: Nate Wooding
channel.description: Coconut water reviews and other things.

item.title: Cocochito — with Pulp (4.1/10)
item.description: A heavily sweetened Thai water with added pulp. Bitter and sweet at the same time, with highly variable pulp. Overall: 4.1/10.

item.title: Coaqua — Still Coconut Water (6.6/10)
item.description: Single-origin Vietnamese coconut water with millennial marketing to match. Smooth and milky but the added sugar makes it less refreshing. Overall: 6.6/10.

item.title: Harmless Harvest — Organic Sparkling (7.4/10)
item.description: The OG pink water, carbonated. Industry-leading ethics, unpasteurized, but the floral flavor doesn't quite work with bubbles. Overall: 7.4/10.
